caption: The drawing features a vertical, rectangular composition with a cream or light beige background. At the base, three curving green leafy shapes suggest stylized tufts of grass or plant bases. From these bases, three main wavy stems extend upward, branching into thinner tendrils. Along the stems and branches, there are various flowers, leaves, and buds in multiple colors. The flowers are depicted in red, pink, yellow, blue, and green, with each flower showing distinct shapes and patterns, sometimes outlined in contrasting colors. Some flowers are large and multi-petaled, while others are small and simple. There are also round fruit-like forms in yellow and peach, as well as elongated blue leaves and smaller green and pink leaves. The lines connecting the elements are mostly thin and dark, curving delicately throughout the design. The overall look is ornate and balanced, with the elements finely distributed across the pale background.
title: Crewel Embroidery
